14.expectation: Internet Archive snapshots of NYSE's own pages captured shortly after each ad-hoc closure announcement (nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars or an NYSE/ICE notice) state that NYSE markets closed on Wednesday 2018-12-05 (President George H.W. Bush national day of mourning) and Thursday 2025-01-09 (President Jimmy Carter national day of mourning).
14.criteria: For each date, a retained archived NYSE/ICE page (snapshot timestamp and sha256 recorded) whose extracted text contains that date together with a closure statement. Detection: the extractor reports every 'Month D, YYYY' date appearing within 300 characters of 'clos' in the page text; a self-test on an injected sentence must report the injected date, and a non-closure date on the same page (negative control) must not be reported as a closure. If no snapshot can be found or parsed within the 20-minute bound, record that and leave the clause open. Outcome stays advanced in any case: security-specific halts remain unchecked.

eol_fix.label: round-3 integrity-fix preregistration, written after git reported CRLF normalization on commit 78be820 and before any file was rewritten
eol_fix.finding: five published raw HTML files have CRLF line endings in the worktree while .gitattributes (* text=auto eol=lf) stores LF; the manifest and receipts hash the CRLF bytes, so a fresh checkout mismatches. Two are round-2 files already committed (6-nasdaqtrader-holiday-calendar.html, 7-quantconnect-terms.html); three are round-3 NYSE snapshots.
eol_fix.expectation: Normalizing the five worktree files to LF makes their sha256 equal the committed blob hash; venue_pages_check.py (gap 6), lean_rights.py if it reads the QuantConnect page (gap 7) and archive_calendar_check.py (gaps 6/14) produce the same results on the LF copies.
eol_fix.criteria: For each file: worktree sha256 == git blob sha256 after the change. Check outputs compared with the committed outputs (sha256 fields excluded); any difference is reported. REDACTIONS.json records the normalization.
